manaNeeded: {2}{U}{U} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one creature.
You have enough mana to cast Will of the Temur
description:
Cast Will of the Temur by paying its mana cost, targeting a creature you control.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {2}{U}{U} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Naru Meha enters the battlefield, it triggers, copying Will of the Temur, targeting Naru Meha.
Resolve the copy of Will of the Temur, creating a token copy of Naru Meha.
Put either Naru Meha into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Repeat from step 3.
